issues.on_page: 5000 Other miscellaneous expense 400 (Bond Fund, debt service code 5000); statement p6 prints it on the 'Debt service: Fees' row
issues.issue: [fixed: now debt service interest / debt interest and fees] The report identifies this as a debt service fee. Category should be 'debt service interest' and detail_category 'debt interest and fees', not other/miscellaneous. It also disagrees with disbursements[16], where the same 400 is debt service interest.

issues.on_page: Other income 6,620 (p9: 1990 Other local receipts 1,639 + 2210 ESU receipts 3,706 + 1941 Sale of books 1,275)
issues.issue: The report says what this line is made of. Its largest part is ESU receipts (intergovernmental, county/other local governments), so 'other' is arguably not the best category for a mixed line.

The statement (p5) folds this line into General Fund 'Building and grounds' 1,040,966 (= 940,966 + 100,000), which is support services. The extractor assumed the 100,000 Building-and-grounds elimination on p6 is this line and offset it with contra detail[40] plus transfer detail[41]. That handling follows the rules and nets to zero, but the page does not say which line holds the transfer.
